scenario.title: Charging power loss across the timeout, and recovery afterwards -- timeout = 100ms, expected legal
scenario.description:
Silence the charger for a range of durations either side of the declared window. Short of it the session must continue; once elapsed the pack must announce CHARGE_LOST and open the contactor, and then close it again when the charger returns, because this rule does not latch.
Generated from pattern 'node-silent' by harness/expand.py.
This variant places timeout at 100ms, which is the mandatory legal member of the boundary of timeout = 300ms under a non-strict comparison.
The expected outcome for this variant is legal.
